# System and Acceptance Test Cases

**Project:** Moderated LMS  
**Document:** SAT-LMS-01  
**Status:** Console system scenarios and role demonstrations executed on 2 November 2026. Detailed outcomes are in `system-test-execution.md`; automated console evidence is generated by `tests/system/ConsoleWorkflowTest.py`. Formal stakeholder sign-off remains outstanding.

## Preconditions

- Build the application and prepare a disposable test database using the project's schema and seed data.
- Create/identify one active test account per role (Student, Lecturer, HoD, Admin), plus an inactive account and invalid credentials.
- Prepare an assignment with a known deadline and maximum mark, a student enrolled in the course, and a lecturer assigned to the course.
- Reset the test database before each independent scenario. Do not test against production/student data.

| ID | Role / flow | Steps | Expected result | Actual result / evidence |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| ST-01 | Authentication | Log in with valid active credentials; log out; try unknown username, wrong password and inactive account | Valid account enters the correct role menu; invalid/inactive account is denied without exposing password/hash details or crashing | **PASS for tested paths:** first-run admin and invalid-login checks passed; a newly created account was deactivated and its subsequent login was denied. Evidence: `docs/testing/evidence/ST-01-auth-smoke.txt` and `ST-01-inactive-and-db-failure.txt`. |
| ST-02 | Role permissions | Sign in as each of the four roles and attempt one allowed and one disallowed action | Allowed action is available; disallowed action is blocked by the application/service, not merely hidden in the menu | **PASS for tested paths:** cross-course student/lecturer and cross-department HoD attempts were denied; see `system-test-execution.md`. |
| ST-03 | Student submission | Submit before deadline; resubmit before deadline; submit more than three days late | Submission persists; each attempt is retained; latest attempt is current; work later than three days receives zero | **PASS:** real console test verified two preserved attempts and zero final mark for work more than three days late. |
| ST-04 | Deadline exception | Attempt submission for an unknown assignment and as a student not enrolled in the course; provide invalid input | Operation is rejected with a useful message; no unrelated record is changed; application continues safely | **PASS for tested exception paths:** non-enrolled student and unknown assignment were rejected without creating submission rows; additional invalid-input boundaries remain outstanding. |
| ST-05 | Lecturer marking | Mark an existing submission with valid mark and feedback; try negative and over-maximum marks; try marking a missing submission | Valid mark/feedback persist; invalid mark and missing record are rejected; no invalid mark is stored | **PASS for tested paths:** valid mark persisted; over-maximum mark, missing submission and cross-course marking were rejected without changing the target submission/audit data. |
| ST-06 | HoD moderation and release | HoD reviews a marked submission, moderates it and releases it; student checks mark before and after release | Moderation/release follows workflow; unreleased marks are hidden from student; released mark and feedback become visible | **PASS for moderation, approval, release and released-mark display.** See `system-test-execution.md`. |
| ST-07 | Cross-department access | HoD attempts to review or moderate a record outside their department, if department scoping is implemented | Access is denied or record is excluded from HoD view according to requirements | **PASS for a live negative attempt:** another-department submission was rejected without changing its record. |
| ST-08 | Database failure | Start with invalid database path; inject an active-session write failure during submission | Error is reported safely; no false success; transaction leaves no partial rows | **PASS for both tested paths:** startup failure exits non-zero with a diagnostic; active-session write failure is caught and all submission-related rows remain empty. |
| AT-01 | Admin acceptance | Admin creates/manages user accounts and sets up course/assignment relationships | Changes persist and the user can sign in with the assigned role | **PARTIAL:** create, profile registration, enrolment and course assignment were demonstrated; user-account update is not implemented. Formal stakeholder sign-off remains outstanding. |
| AT-02 | Lecturer acceptance | Lecturer creates an assignment, sets deadline/maximum mark, grants an individual extension and marks a submission | Assignment and extension persist; marking enforces allowed range and records feedback | **PASS for demonstrated workflow:** assignment, extension and mark/feedback persisted. Formal sign-off remains outstanding. |
| AT-03 | HoD acceptance | HoD reviews departmental marks, records moderation and releases approved marks | Department's marks can be reviewed; release occurs only after moderation; mark changes are auditable | **PASS for demonstrated workflow:** moderation, approval, release and audit history verified. Formal sign-off remains outstanding. |
| AT-04 | Student acceptance | Student views enrolled course/assignment, submits/resubmits work, and views mark/feedback before and after release | Student can use own permitted workflows and cannot see unreleased marks or other students' records | **PASS for demonstrated workflow:** submission, resubmission and released-mark visibility verified; cross-student/unreleased visibility denied. Formal sign-off remains outstanding. |

## Execution record template

For each test, record date/time, build commit/hash, tester, database fixture/seed version, exact steps, expected result, actual result, Pass/Fail/Blocked, and evidence filename. A scenario is not a pass until it has actually been run. If a feature needed for a scenario is not implemented, mark it **Blocked/Not implemented** and link a defect or requirement gap; do not mark it passed.


## Traceability to the Phase 3 design

| Test case | Phase 3 model / layer | Role or component | Evidence |
|---|---|---|---|
| ST-01 | Presentation → `AuthService` → SQLite users | All roles | Login and inactive-account system evidence; `AuthServiceTest` |
| ST-02 / ST-07 | Role policy, course lecturer and HoD department associations | Student, Lecturer, HoD, Admin | `SQLiteAuthorizationPolicyTest.cpp`; cross-scope system evidence |
| ST-03 / AT-04 | Submit Assignment sequence and Submission lifecycle | Student | `SubmissionService`, `submission_attempts`, console system test |
| ST-04 / IT-05 / IT-07 | Deadline and extension business rules | Student / Lecturer | Fixed-time deadline and extension integration tests |
| ST-05 / AT-02 | `MarkingService`, `ILatePenaltyStrategy`, audit repository | Lecturer | Marking service tests, workflow integration and console test |
| ST-06 / AT-03 | `ModerationService`, `Mark_Record`, `Audit_Log` | HoD | End-to-end integration workflow |
| ST-08 / IT-10 | Repository/DAO and SQLite transaction boundary | All roles | Console and integration write-failure tests |
| AT-01 / IT-04 | `AdminService`, users, departments, courses, profiles and enrolments | Administrator | Admin integration test; user update gap in defect log |

The machine-readable requirements mapping is in `docs/traceability.csv`. External stakeholder approval is pending and must be completed by an authorised school representative; it must not be self-certified by the developer.
